away_sentinel.label: Away sentinel file
away_sentinel.description: Path lan-mouse.nix's enter_hook writes (holding the peer's name) while control is away, and removes when it returns. Supports $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and ~ expansion.

incoming_sentinel.label: Incoming sentinel file
incoming_sentinel.description: Path lan-mouse.nix's enter_hook writes on this host (holding the source host's name) while a peer's input is flowing in. Gates the lockscreen button's visibility. Supports $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and ~ expansion.

poll_interval.label: Poll interval (s)
poll_interval.description: How often to re-check the sentinel file and re-run lan-mouse cli list.

icon_color.label: Icon color
icon_color.description: A Noctalia color role (e.g. error, primary) or a hex color, used while control is away.

show_label.label: Show label
show_label.description: Show the peer name next to the icon in the bar. Disable for an icon-only indicator.

go_back_command.label: Go-back command
go_back_command.description: Path to the script the lockscreen's "Bring input back" button runs. Set by lan-mouse.nix's goBackScript; only change this if you know what you're doing.

stop_command.label: Stop command
stop_command.description: Shell command run by the panel's "Stop" button. Leave empty to run `systemctl --user stop lan-mouse.service`.
